title: mul migrated to TensorIterator slowed real applications 15-20%
notes: Reporter bisected a whole-application 15-20% MPS slowdown from 2.7.1->2.9.0 to this PR and restored performance by simply un-registering mul_stub, i.e. falling back to MPSGraph. Their diagnosis: the Metal kernel widens half inputs to fp32 for accuracy they did not need. No opt-out exists. This is why fp16/bf16 lanes are never averaged with fp32.
